name: Ghost Editorial
tagline: ghost-editor's editorial: lowercase captions that blur in, the previous line fading light, tilted red tag pills, highlight wipes.

motion.direction: ghost-editor `editorial`. Lowercase captions blur in (blur 10 px, y 10 → 0, 0.26 s power3.out); the previous line turns light (weight 300, 86 % white) while the new one lands. Tilted accent tag pills (`chips`, scale 0.5 rot −16° → rot −6° in 0.3 s back.out) in red `ter`; a highlight bar wiping scaleX in 0.28 s under the key word. Full-screen scenes 30–50 % of runtime: a `chapterCard` as a sentence card, a `counter` stats card, a grayscale `imageCard`. Scene ins: blur 28 px 0.22 s or a clip-expand 0.42 s expo.inOut; the camera glides. Tense, minimal; music far under.
